UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.message: Input is not a supported spectrum format or channel count.
UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.action: Do not interpolate or rebin. Return the rejection reason and stop.

INVALID_COUNTS.message: Counts fail the five-field contract (length, finiteness, non-negativity, integer type or total).
INVALID_COUNTS.action: Reject; do not fall back to a default spectrum.

INTEGRITY_FAILED.message: Frozen model package or dependency hash does not match the registry.
INTEGRITY_FAILED.action: Stop without producing content; do not recompute a hash to 'fix' the mismatch.

TIMEOUT.message: Numerical backend exceeded the task timeout.
TIMEOUT.action: Terminate the subprocess, mark failed, clean temp files; one justified recovery only.

NUMERICAL_FAILURE.message: The model process exited without publishing a valid result.
NUMERICAL_FAILURE.action: Stop; do not emit a fallback content guess.

OVERWRITE_REFUSED.message: A result for this job already exists and overwrite is not permitted.
OVERWRITE_REFUSED.action: Return the existing job id and artifact refs.

NOT_FOUND.message: No job with this id exists in this workspace.
NOT_FOUND.action: Do not enumerate or read other directories.

PATH_TRAVERSAL.message: A requested path escapes the job or workspace root.

CONTRACT_VIOLATION.message: A tool argument breaks a documented tool contract.
CONTRACT_VIOLATION.action: Reject; do not guess the intended argument.

AWAITING_INPUT.message: The job needs additional user input before it can run.
AWAITING_INPUT.action: Ask for the specific missing field; do not fill it with a guess.

RUNTIME_MISMATCH.message: The numerical runtime (Python or numpy/scipy/xraylib versions) does not match the declared runtime policy.
RUNTIME_MISMATCH.action: Stop before inference or cache use; record the actual versions; never silently fall back to another interpreter. Proceed only with an explicit --allow-unverified-runtime opt-in, which records the unverified status.

DEPENDENCY_MISSING.message: A numerical dependency the frozen model needs is missing from the selected interpreter.
DEPENDENCY_MISSING.action: Stop before inference; report which dependency is missing; do not substitute another interpreter silently.
